rules.embedding: alarm when 5-fold CV ROC-AUC > threshold (99th percentile on clean val)
rules.pixel: alarm when -log10(min KS p) > threshold, i.e. min p < 0.01/3
rules.confidence: alarm when KS statistic > threshold (99th percentile on clean val)

reference.clean_batches: embedding/pixel: clean val; confidence: the other val half
